data_description.disks_enable: Ако работите с хибернация на диска, трябва да деактивирате тази опция за интегриране, за да не причинява неоправдано повторно активиране на дисковете.
data_description.auto_discovery: Track every node, virtual machine, container and storage the credentials can see, and follow the cluster from then on: whatever is added is picked up, whatever is removed is dropped. The selection above is ignored while this is on. Templates are never tracked.
data_description.entity_id_scheme: Standard: Home Assistant's device then name, `qemu_win11_108_cpu_used`. Extended: prefix, kind, id, name, item - `pve_qemu_108_win11_cpu_used` - so a search or a recorder filter catches everything by the prefix and a list sorts by id. Applies to entities created from now on; ids that exist keep them.
data_description.entity_id_prefix: The first part of every entity id under the extended scheme; `pve` unless you choose otherwise. Not used by the standard scheme.

abort.no_resources: За тази инстанция не бяха върнати ресурси.

import_success.title: {host}:{port} беше импортиран от YAML настройката
import_success.description:
YAML настройката на {host}:{port} инстанцията на {integration} (`{platform}`) е импортирана в потребителския интерфейс автоматично.

Може безопасно да се премахне от вашия файл `configuration.yaml`.

import_invalid_port.title: Грешка при импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port}
import_invalid_port.description:
Импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port} инстанцията на {integration} (`{platform}`) не бе успешно поради невалиден порт.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия файл `configuration.yaml`, да рестартирате Home Assistant и конфигурирайте го ръчно.

import_auth_error.title: Грешка при импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port}
import_auth_error.description:
Импортиране на YAML настройката от {host}:{port} инстанцията на {integration} (`{platform}`) неуспешно поради грешка при удостоверяване.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл, да рестартирате Home Assistant и ръчно да го настройте.

import_ssl_rejection.title: Въззникна грешка при импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port}
import_ssl_rejection.description:
Импортиране на YAML настройката от {host}:{port} инстанцията на {integration} (`{platform}`) неуспешно поради отхвърляне на SSL.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл, да рестартирате Home Assistant и ръчно да го настройте.

import_cant_connect.title: Грешка при импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port}
import_cant_connect.description:
Импортиране на YAML настройката от {host}:{port} инстанция на {integration} (`{platform}`) неуспешно поради неуспешно свързване.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл, да рестартирате Home Assistant и ръчно да го настройте.

import_general_error.title: Грешка при импортирането на YAML настройката от {host}:{port}
import_general_error.description:
Импортиране на YAML настройката от {host}:{port} инстанция на {integration} (`{platform}`) неуспешно поради неизвестна грешка.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл, да рестартирате Home Assistant и ръчно да го настройте.

import_already_configured.title: Инстанцията {host}:{port} вече съществува в UI, но може да се премахне
import_already_configured.description:
YAML настройката {host}:{port} на инстанцията {integration} (`{platform}`) вече съществува в потребителския интерфейс и е игнориран при импортиране.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл и да рестартирате Home Assistant.

import_node_not_exist.title: Възелът {node} не съществува в {host}:{port}
import_node_not_exist.description:
Възълът {node} на {host}:{port} инстанцията на интеграцията {integration} (`{platform}`) в YAML настройката не съществува в този случай и е игнориран при импортирането.

Трябва да премахнете тази настройка от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл и да рестартирате Home Assistant.

yaml_deprecated.title: Настройката на {integration} в YAML е остарял
yaml_deprecated.description:
Настройката на {integration} (`{platform}`) в YAML е остарял и трябва да бъде премахнат {version}.

Разрешете проблемите с импортирането и премахнете YAML настройката от вашия `configuration.yaml` файл.

resources_nonexistent.description:
These resources are tracked, but the cluster at `{host}:{port}` does not list them. Remove them in the integration options - or, if they do exist, user `{user}` may lack the privilege to see them, noted after each one:

{items}
resources_nonexistent.title: {count} tracked resource(s) not found on {host}

no_permissions.description:
Потребителят `{user}` няма необходимите права за всички функции.

Следните функции не са достъпни от потребителя:
`{errors}`

Проверете потребителските права, както е описано в документацията.
no_permissions.title: Потребителят `{user}` не притежава необходимите права

resources_forbidden.title: {count} resource(s) not readable by `{user}`

guest_agent_fsinfo_forbidden.description:
User `{user}` may not query the QEMU guest agent of these VMs: {vms}.

Their disk usage falls back to what the host sees - for most VMs that is nothing. Reading it needs, on the VMs or on a path above them:
* `{permission}`

On Proxmox VE 8 the privilege is `VM.Monitor` instead. The built-in `PVEAuditor` role carries it. Grant it and reload the integration.
guest_agent_fsinfo_forbidden.title: Guest agent not readable

guest_agent_file_forbidden.description:
User `{user}` may not read files through the QEMU guest agent of these VMs: {vms}.

Their guest file sensor cannot be created. Reading it needs, on the VMs or on a path above them:
* `{permission}`

On Proxmox VE 8 the privilege is `VM.Monitor` instead. Grant it and reload the integration, or clear the file path in the integration options.
guest_agent_file_forbidden.title: Guest file not readable

resource_command_forbiden.description:
Потребителят `{user}` няма необходимите права да изпълни `{command}` командата на ресурса `{resource}`.

Съвет относно необходимите права:
* `{permission}`

Моля, проверете документацията и потребителските права.
resource_command_forbiden.title: Грешка в разрешението за `{resource}` командата

cluster_ha_auth.description: Optional and separate from the main credentials above. Enables the Arm HA / Disarm HA buttons and a per-VM/CT "HA managed" sensor. These require Sys.Console and Sys.Audit permissions on the Proxmox root path ('/') — significantly broader than anything else this integration needs, and enough to affect the whole cluster's HA fencing behavior. Only fill this in if you understand and accept that risk; leave every field empty to leave these features disabled.

data_description.ha_admin_username: Leave empty (along with the fields below) to disable the Arm/Disarm HA buttons and the HA managed sensor.
data_description.ha_admin_password: Needs Sys.Console (arm/disarm) and Sys.Audit (HA resource list) on '/' — not the scoped permissions recommended for the main integration user.

change_expose.description: Select the Proxmox instance nodes and Virtual Machines (QEMU) and Containers (LXC) you want to expose

data_description.auto_discovery: Track every node, virtual machine, container and storage the credentials can see, and follow the cluster from then on: whatever is added is picked up, whatever is removed is dropped. The selection above is ignored while this is on. Templates are never tracked.

advanced.title: Advanced configuration
advanced.description: What is read besides the basics, how often, and how entities are named. Every field has a default a setup runs fine on.

data.guest_file_path: Guest file path to monitor (QEMU, requires guest agent)
data.backup_storage: Backup storage for the backup buttons

data_description.disks_enable: Ако работите с хибернация на диска, трябва да деактивирате тази опция за интегриране, така че да не причинява неоправдано повторно активиране на дисковете.
data_description.tasks_enable: Track and report failed tasks from the last 24 hours on selected nodes.
data_description.updates_enable: Read the pending package upgrades of each node into an update entity and a count sensor. Needs Sys.Modify on the node; switch this off to run without that privilege - or without the entities.
data_description.update_interval: How often nodes, guests, storage and backups are read. 60 seconds unless changed; Proxmox itself refreshes guest figures about every 10 seconds. Certificates, subscriptions and Ceph are read hourly, failed tasks every five minutes, whatever is set here.
data_description.guest_file_path: Absolute path of a file inside each tracked QEMU guest to read via the guest agent and expose as a sensor. Leave empty to disable. Requires the QEMU guest agent to be running in the guest.
data_description.backup_storage: Where the "Back up now" and "Back up all" buttons write their backups (snapshot mode). The buttons exist only while a storage is picked here and the credentials hold VM.Backup. Storages that accept backups are listed; any other name can be typed in.
data_description.entity_id_scheme: Standard: Home Assistant's device then name, `qemu_win11_108_cpu_used`. Extended: prefix, kind, id, name, item - `pve_qemu_108_win11_cpu_used` - so a search or a recorder filter catches everything by the prefix and a list sorts by id. Applies to entities created from now on; ids that exist keep them.
data_description.entity_id_prefix: The first part of every entity id under the extended scheme; `pve` unless you choose otherwise. Not used by the standard scheme.

options.standard: Standard - device then name (Home Assistant default)
options.extended: Extended - prefix, kind, id, name, item

backup.name: Back up guests
backup.description: Starts backup runs (vzdump) for the targeted guests, nodes or cluster - or for the node and guest ids named. One run per node; returns their task ids.

node.name: Node
node.description: A node to back up on, by name. Not needed when devices are targeted or guests are named: their node is looked up.

vmid.name: Guests
vmid.description: IDs of VMs and containers to back up, wherever in the cluster they live.

all.name: All
all.description: Back up every guest the node hosts - on the named node, or on every tracked node when none is named or targeted.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Where to store the backup. Defaults to the storage picked for the backup buttons in the integration options, or to the node's own default.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How to freeze the guest: snapshot (no downtime), suspend, or stop.

compress.name: Compression
compress.description: zstd, gzip, lzo, or none. Defaults to the node's setting.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Notes template for the backup, for example {{guestname}}.

skip_if_running.name: Skip if running
skip_if_running.description: Leave a node out while a backup is already running on it, instead of queuing behind it.

backup_nothing_selected.message: Target a guest, node or cluster device, name a guest or node, or turn on 'All'.

backup_target_not_supported.message: {device} cannot be backed up; target a guest, a node or the cluster.

backup_unknown_guest.message: No configured Proxmox VE integration tracks guest {vmid}.

backup_notes_need_storage.message: Notes can only be set together with a storage; Proxmox refuses the template without one.

backup_unknown_node.message: No configured Proxmox VE integration tracks node {node}.

backup_refused.message: Proxmox refused to start the backup on {node}: {error}

backup_unreachable.message: Node {node} could not be reached to start the backup: {error}
